title: Firmware Extraction and Analysis
summary: Planned notes on extracting firmware, identifying embedded filesystems, and examining binaries, configuration files, exposed services, and stored credentials.
scope: This planned series will examine firmware extraction and filesystem analysis with binwalk, followed by inspection of binaries and configuration in embedded Linux images. Topics include hardcoded credentials, command injection, and exposed services.

items: Choose a device from the owned lab inventory and record its provenance.

outline.heading: Findings and disclosure
items: Record each observation with its supporting artifact.
Assess impact and remediation options.
Follow coordinated disclosure before publishing sensitive details.
